visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a blurred view of a bright convenience store interior. A vibrant text overlay appears in the center reading '一起來逛日本超商 近期新品 綜合篇', accompanied by the logos of FamilyMart, 7-Eleven, and Lawson. The lighting is uniform and bright. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a refrigerated shelf at FamilyMart stocked with Snoopy and Charlie Brown themed sandwiches and sweets. A person's hand with white manicured nails points at the sandwich packaging. The background features other chilled items and price tags. (3) The camera transitions to a shelf of savory snacks. A hand takes a bag of Calbee 'Noko King' cheese and basil potato chips. The hand opens the bag and presents a single ruffled, yellow-colored chip to the camera against a background of colorful snack aisles. (4) At a 7-Eleven, the camera captures rows of Hokkaido dairy yogurt with grape and aloe. A hand removes a cup, and a cut shows a top-down view of the opened yogurt where a spoon lifts a large, translucent green grape from the white cream. (5) The scene cuts to 7-Eleven brand sweet potato sticks and chips. The hand holds up a dark purple stick-shaped snack and then a round, thin slice of sweet potato. The lighting remains consistent and clear, highlighting the textures of the food items. (6) In Lawson, the camera focuses on 'Aerial' caramel-flavored puffed snacks. The hand holds a single square snack, showing its distinctive four-layered structure through a macro close-up shot. The background is slightly out of focus, emphasizing the product's intricate geometric layers. (7) The final segment shows Bourbon chocolate-covered potato chips from Lawson. The hand holds one chip, showcasing the glossy milk chocolate coating on one side and the ruffled potato texture. The video maintains a rapid, montage-like editing style with frequent cuts and clear lighting.

This incidental noise has high-frequency energy and is layered directly over the ongoing upbeat music. The music maintains its volume intensity without ducking. These sound events are brief but clearly audible. (4) Additional plastic bag rustling occurs as the person handles sweet potato and puffed corn snacks. The sound is sharp and tactile. The background music continues its major-key progression with consistent vocal and instrumental textures, providing a high-energy backdrop. (5) The final segment features more rustling sounds as chocolate potato chips are shown. The audio remains clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio. The song's rhythmic beat and the male singer's voice continue until the end, with no strategic silences or significant edits.
